messages:
sam: Heads-up — CI failing in audit-validator after yesterday's RBAC mapping tweak. Golden fixtures mismatch for keystore/rewrap events: validator complains 'actor' missing at $.events[*].actor. Anyone run into this? @erin @raj

erin: I saw this locally. Repro: run `pytest tests/audit/test_validator.py::test_keystore_events -k rewrap` with AUDIT_GOLDEN=1. The RBAC shim started returning `\{"actor\": null\}` for system-initiated rewraps.

raj: CI logs show: `AssertionError: missing key 'actor.id' at path $.keystore.rewrap` — looks like the new kms-rewrap branch adds a redaction header that ends up dropping the id. Pasting trimmed validator output:
```
ValidatorError: Missing required field
Path: $.events[0].actor.id
Got: null
Expected: string
```

ci-bot: audit-validator CI — job failed on commit abc123. :warning: Rerun available: `ci rerun abc123`

sam: My hunch: KMS integration changed envelope metadata for rewraps to mark system actors differently. The validator currently treats any actor without id as a schema violation. Two options: (1) add canonical system actor entries to golden fixtures, or (2) relax schema to allow actor.type='system' without id. Thoughts?

erin: I can push a quick patch to update goldens to include `actor.id = \"system:keystore\"` and update the fixture generator to emit system actor ids for rewraps. Safer to keep id present if possible.

maria: fyi — we recently started adding `actor.redacted: true` in envelopes for PII-sensitive operations with the KMS changes. That may be why id is being dropped. We should consider making `actor.redacted` an optional field in the schema instead of dropping id. I can review the PR and validate the rewrap flows against real envelopes.

raj: Proposed short plan:
1) Reproduce locally (done by erin)
2) Update golden fixtures and fixture generator (erin)
3) Add schema note + migration guidance (sam/maria)
4) Run full audit-validator CI and unblock downstream tests (ci)
Who can review the golden changes? @maria?

sam: Marking this P1 test-flake/regression for now. If this surfaces in customer-facing logs we'll escalate to an incident channel. For immediate CI unblocking, hotfix idea: allow `actor.id` optional when `actor.type == \"system\"` and `actor.redacted == true` — temporary until goldens updated. :+1:

erin: PR incoming — #4623 will update goldens, add unit to cover system rewrap, and include changelog entry. cc @maria for KMS review.

raj: Also opening a follow-up ticket to add a Golden Drift watcher in CI (notify when golden diffs > 0.5% tokens). This should catch infra-induced fixture drift earlier. Filing now.

ci-bot: PR 4623 created by erin — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/4623

maria: I'll review the PR today and test against a small set of redaction envelopes. If we need to change the validator to accept `actor.redacted`, let's coordinate on the schema change PR so client teams aren't surprised.

sam: Thanks all — please post updates here and tag if you need an incident page.
